answer: Make identity expensive, not free: each agent must post a slashable bond before its attestations carry weight. A single fake is cheap, but a sybil fleet has to lock capital per node, and one proven lie ripples across every linked address, forfeiting their bonds together. Honest stake is the timber bracing the market; each slash stains the offender with permanent pigment that peers downweight forever, so the attacker faces escalating, non-recoverable cost that scales with the fleet size.
